[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]A silver-faced Mechon...[XENO:n ]
And who was that girl?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]These visions show me people[XENO:n ]
and places I've never seen.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]If only I could find out what they mean.[XENO:n ]
We could use them to our advantage.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Look over there! A rope bridge![XENO:n ]
It looks Homs-made.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Not Homs, Nopon. Though a lot of them have settled in our[XENO:n ]
colonies, the Nopon are originally native to Makna Forest.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Do you think they'd know the way to the Giant God's head?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I can't say. But walking around in circles isn't[XENO:n ]
going to achieve anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Our best bet is to look for their village.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
